WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    request,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
    END AS local_operator_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id')::uuid
    END AS book_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,chapter_id}', request->>'chapter_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,chapter_id}', request->>'chapter_id')::uuid
    END AS chapter_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,chapter_version_id}', request->>'chapter_version_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,chapter_version_id}', request->>'chapter_version_id')::uuid
    END AS chapter_version_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,editor_log_id}', request->>'editor_log_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,editor_log_id}', request->>'editor_log_id')::uuid
    END AS editor_log_id
  FROM input
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    p.id AS scoped_book_id
  FROM normalized AS n
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS p
    ON p.id = n.book_id
   AND p.local_operator_id = n.local_operator_id
), resolved AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    returned_version.returned_version_id,
    returned_version.returned_version,
    returned_version.returned_progress,
    returned_version.returned_text,
    returned_version.reject_count,
    formal_version.formal_version_id,
    formal_version.formal_version,
    decision.editor_log_id AS confirmed_return_editor_log_id,
    binding.runtime_binding
  FROM scoped AS s
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      cv.id AS returned_version_id,
      cv.deduction_progress_json AS returned_progress,
      cv.prose_text AS returned_text,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(cv.deduction_progress_json->>'reject_count', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
        THEN (cv.deduction_progress_json->>'reject_count')::integer
        ELSE NULL
      END AS reject_count,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', cv.id,
        'version_no', cv.version_no,
        'version_state', cv.version_state,
        'is_shadow', cv.is_shadow,
        'target_snapshot_json', cv.target_snapshot_json,
        'chapter_implementation_json', cv.chapter_implementation_json,
        'candidate_plot_sim_json', cv.candidate_plot_sim_json,
        'deduction_progress_json', cv.deduction_progress_json,
        'prose_text', cv.prose_text,
        'prose_summary', cv.prose_summary,
        'review_decision', cv.review_decision,
        'review_comment', cv.review_comment
      ) AS returned_version
    FROM public.chapter_version AS cv
    WHERE cv.id = s.chapter_version_id
      AND cv.book_id = s.scoped_book_id
      AND cv.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
      AND (
        (cv.version_state = 'candidate' AND cv.is_valid AND NOT cv.is_shadow)
        OR
        (cv.version_state = 'shadow' AND NOT cv.is_valid AND cv.is_shadow)
      )
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS returned_version ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      previous.id AS formal_version_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', previous.id,
        'version_no', previous.version_no,
        'version_state', previous.version_state,
        'target_snapshot_json', previous.target_snapshot_json,
        'candidate_plot_sim_json', previous.candidate_plot_sim_json,
        'formal_plot_sim_json', previous.formal_plot_sim_json,
        'prose_text', previous.prose_text,
        'prose_summary', previous.prose_summary
      ) AS formal_version
    FROM public.chapter_version AS previous
    WHERE previous.book_id = s.scoped_book_id
      AND previous.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
      AND previous.version_state = 'formal'
      AND previous.is_formal
      AND previous.is_valid
      AND NOT previous.is_shadow
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS formal_version ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT e.id AS editor_log_id
    FROM public.editor_log AS e
    WHERE e.id = s.editor_log_id
      AND e.book_id = s.scoped_book_id
      AND e.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
      AND e.chapter_version_id = returned_version.returned_version_id
      AND e.phase = 'editorial'
      AND e.creator_confirmed
      AND e.decision_json->>'verdict' = 'N'
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS decision ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'node_code', b.node_code,
      'model_config_id', b.model_config_id,
      'model_config_version', b.model_config_version,
      'prompt_config_id', b.prompt_config_id,
      'prompt_version', b.prompt_version,
      'template_type', b.template_type,
      'temperature', b.temperature,
      'prompt_text', b.prompt_text,
      'prompt_status', b.prompt_status,
      'model_name', b.model_name,
      'provider_base_url', b.provider_base_url,
      'api_key_ref', b.api_key_ref,
      'routing_config_jsonb', b.routing_config_jsonb,
      'parameters_jsonb', b.parameters_jsonb
    ) AS runtime_binding
    FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
    WHERE b.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
      AND b.node_code = 'FP012-03'
      AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY b.model_config_version DESC, b.prompt_version DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS binding ON true
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'request', r.request,
  'returned_version', r.returned_version,
  'previous_formal_version', r.formal_version,
  'audit_attempts', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', a.id,
      'chapter_version_id', a.chapter_version_id,
      'audit_type', a.audit_type,
      'has_p0_blocker', a.has_p0_blocker,
      'p0_items_json', a.p0_items_json,
      'audit_findings_jsonb', a.audit_findings_jsonb,
      'return_route_suggestion_jsonb', a.return_route_suggestion_jsonb,
      'audit_status', a.audit_status,
      'is_shadow', a.is_shadow,
      'is_valid', a.is_valid
    ) ORDER BY a.created_at, a.id)
    FROM public.audit_attempt_log AS a
    WHERE a.book_id = r.scoped_book_id
      AND a.chapter_id = r.chapter_id
      AND a.chapter_version_id IN (r.returned_version_id, r.formal_version_id)
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'editor_decisions', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', e.id,
      'chapter_version_id', e.chapter_version_id,
      'phase', e.phase,
      'decision_json', e.decision_json,
      'score_json', e.score_json,
      'fix_instruction_json', e.fix_instruction_json,
      'review_comment', e.review_comment,
      'creator_confirmed', e.creator_confirmed,
      'is_shadow', e.is_shadow,
      'is_valid', e.is_valid
    ) ORDER BY e.created_at, e.id)
    FROM public.editor_log AS e
    WHERE e.book_id = r.scoped_book_id
      AND e.chapter_id = r.chapter_id
      AND e.chapter_version_id IN (r.returned_version_id, r.formal_version_id)
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'narrative_assets', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', na.id,
      'chapter_version_id', na.chapter_version_id,
      'asset_type', na.asset_type,
      'asset_name', na.asset_name,
      'asset_description', na.asset_description,
      'hook_category', na.hook_category,
      'status', na.status,
      'evidence_json', na.evidence_json,
      'value_anchor', na.value_anchor,
      'current_effect_json', na.current_effect_json,
      'is_formal', na.is_formal,
      'is_shadow', na.is_shadow,
      'is_valid', na.is_valid
    ) ORDER BY na.created_at, na.id)
    FROM public.narrative_asset AS na
    WHERE na.book_id = r.scoped_book_id
      AND na.linked_chapter_id = r.chapter_id
      AND na.chapter_version_id IN (r.returned_version_id, r.formal_version_id)
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'runtime_binding', COALESCE(r.runtime_binding, '{}'::jsonb),
  'config_ready', r.runtime_binding IS NOT NULL,
  'trigger_ready', r.returned_version_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(r.returned_text, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND r.reject_count = 1
    AND r.confirmed_return_editor_log_id IS NOT NULL,
  'redacted_error', CASE
    WHEN r.scoped_book_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'SCOPE_REJECTED',
      'message', 'The selected book is unavailable.'
    )
    WHEN r.returned_version_id IS NULL
      OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(r.returned_text, '')), '') IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'VERSION_REJECTED',
      'message', 'A returned candidate version with prose is required for shadow analysis.'
    )
    WHEN r.reject_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1
      OR r.confirmed_return_editor_log_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'RETURN_NOT_CONFIRMED',
      'message', 'Shadow analysis only starts after the creator confirms the second return.'
    )
    WHEN r.runtime_binding IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED',
      'message', 'An active FP012-03 model and prompt binding is required before shadow analysis can start.'
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END
) AS context
FROM resolved AS r;
